items.headline: GPT-5.2 Pro proof of Erdős problem #281, later shown to follow from older results
items.summary: Neel Somani posted a ChatGPT (GPT-5.2 Pro) proof answering Erdős problem #281 on covering congruences, and Terence Tao called it "perhaps the most unambiguous instance" of AI solving an open problem. The next day, commenters pointed out a short alternative proof combining the Davenport–Erdős theorem (1936) and a result of Rogers (1966). Tao's wiki records that the AI proof differs from that literature route.
